summary: The Data Architect (Big Data) is responsible for designing data models, pipelines, and governance frameworks to support analytics and machine learning at scale.
responsibilities: Design enterprise-level big data solutions and pipelines
Develop logical and physical data models for analytics and ML workloads
Ensure data consistency, quality, and lineage
Guide implementation of ETL/ELT pipelines and storage strategies
Collaborate with architects, engineers, and business stakeholders

education: 7–10 years of experience in data architecture and engineering

skills_required.name: Data modeling and schema design (star/snowflake, normalized/denormalized)
Expertise in Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, and cloud data platforms
Knowledge of data governance and metadata management
